message: 出動!!　流星クルセイダース

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tch, bummer. I wanted to keep doing the fashion show a little longer.」

name: Synn
message: 「Given the hour, that's it for today's activities. Great work, everyone.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's wrong? Need to take a leak?」

name: Ria
message: 「She asked me to check inside it. Um, the one for student council inauguration something-or-other.」
Nanaka sticks her arm inside the trophy labeled 'Congratulations on the Student Council Inauguration Award' and rummages around.
Nanaka pulls out five slips of paper and holds them up.

name: Ria
message: 「She said we should eat these together to celebrate our inauguration before heading home.」

name: Ria
message: 「Shh! If she hears you say that, she'll get sulky!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yay! It's pork buns from the Five-Star Restaurant!」
Everyone saluted toward the cell phone.

name: Misa
message: 「You were getting all excited without even knowing what it was?」

name: Ria
message: 「Is it not written in the guidebook?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who cares about that? You'll get it once you eat one.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So it is food. I see, I see.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. We cannot say anything for sure until we taste it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Heh heh, I know just what to say. Alright, let's head off before it gets too late.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, come on! Snacking on street food is fun!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't be shy, let's go get treated to some pork buns together!」

name: Synn
message: 「Honestly, they take the bait so easily.」
Ria-senpai pointed right at her own mouth.
I hurriedly wiped my mouth, but there was nothing there.
Grrr, I'm completely dancing to Senpai's tune.
The naginata bag jogged my memory--a familiar girl standing before the school gate.
There was an aura about her, almost as if she had her eyes closed, clearing her mind.
Startled by our quiet footsteps, she snapped back and looked up.
Ria-senpai exchanged greetings with her. So her name is Shio.
Her phrasing made it sound as if she had been waiting for someone.

name: Shio
message: 「Senpai-dono. The air is stir-filled tonight, so please take utmost care.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... Don't do anything reckless either, Shio-chan.\s02」
Bidding her farewell, we walked past the girl named Shio.
Silence returned, and she sank back into meditation.

name: Synn
message: 「Could she be your little sister, Senpai?」
Having a cell phone sure keeps you busy.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... I'm still at the school gate.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you don't get over here fast, it's gonna get cold!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, let's hurry. They're gonna eat our share too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, wait, what? No way, hold on--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey! If you eat them all, I won't forgive you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no, what is this?! What's going on, wait... Eeeeeek!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, let's hurry! I have a bad feeling about this!」
I grabbed Senpai's hand and started sprinting blindly.

name: Nanaka
message: 「This guy suddenly barged in and started making crazy demands, like buying out the whole stock!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If they buy them all up, there won't be any left for us~\s06」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so crushed that we can't eat them...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey~~! Is this really the time to be shocked over something like that?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, we can always eat meat buns tomorrow.」
I looked in the direction of her strained voice.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Lying about buying everything is wrong! You don't look like you have any money at all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on! Don't give up, Synn! Call her a 'blockhead' or something!」

name: Misa
message: 「It looks nothing like the drawing Senpai made...」

name: Misa
message: 「This is no time to be thinking about stupid things!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. This is the opponent we have to fight--a Demon.」
Senpai bit her lip and gripped her Rosary tightly.
Overcome with rage, Nanaka blew a warm breath onto her Rosary. Is she preparing to throw a punch?

name: Paqy
message: 「Pathetic, getting lightheaded over a naked noodle.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm gonna make you grind your back teeth, so brace yourself!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've been waiting for this! The inevitability granted only to the chosen!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The world is in danger, and so are the steamed buns! Justice must prevail, no matter what!」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez, I told you, there's a guy right here!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Woah! Woah! Woah! That's amazing! She really transformed!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah... I think it suits you... probably.\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Look me in the eye and say that!」
Nanaka stood dazed as she watched Lolotte transform.

name: Misa
message: 「I told you! This is why I said it was a bad idea!」
And for the second time today, no less.

name: Synn
message: 「Haah, haah... This might actually be a matter of life or death for me...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, I couldn't care less about an angel's naked body.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hyahooo! I've been waiting for the main event!」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't fool around. This isn't a game.」

name: Misa
message: 「Everyone's transformed... That leaves just me and... But I can't!」

name: Ria
message: 「I understand. I really do. Everyone's scared their first time.」

name: Misa
message: 「Um, no, it's not quite like that, well...」

name: Ria
message: 「But please understand. This is our duty--the mission given to us as the Student Council.」
She grabbed Misa's hand and squeezed it firmly.

name: Misa
message: 「When begged like this, how could I possibly refuse?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I can't take much more of this...」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Ah... That's right. Am I the last one left...?」
Unsteady on his feet, he tightly gripped his Rosary.
Looking ahead, he saw Nanaka swaying unsteadily in much the same way.
Clutched weakly in her hand was a coupon for a free meat bun.
One of the demons charged straight at the defenseless Nanaka.
Is it trying to snatch her free meat bun coupon?!
Stepping in front to shield Nanaka, he blocked the demon's suicide charge with his face.
He had endured up until now, but this impact made all his capillaries burst at once.
At the same time, the color drained from his face.
